resolutions.researcher_notes: Brief flagged both original seed cites (sfegypt.com/4657, petro-news.com/95212) as DEAD_LINK, but url_verifier.py confirms both resolve 200 today with expected Arabic content ('بلطيم'/'بلاعيم') present -- likely a transient outage at brief-generation time. sfegypt.com/4657 (SmartFinance, 2019-08-27, Arabic) reports the 18km/26in offshore + 25km/26in onshore Baltim pipelines and offshore platform completed 3 months ahead of schedule, operator Belayim Petroleum (Petrobel). Corroborated independently by dailynewsegypt.com (2019-08-27, English), which reports the same 18km offshore/25km onshore/26in pipeline completion and names Petrobel (Belayim Petroleum) as operator, with first well due to start production within days -- confirms 'operating' status shortly after. A third source, petro-news.com/95212 (2024-10-10, Arabic, 39-project gas map), independently confirms the project completed Aug 2019 with production Sep 2019-Apr 2020 (currently ~235 mmcf/d + 1,700 bbl/d condensate) but does not name an operator, so it was left out of the operator-ref set and used only as tertiary status corroboration (not included among the two proposed refs to keep the set to the strongest independent pair, but it fully agrees -- no contradiction found). No value contradictions.

sfegypt.com/4657 (Arabic, 2019-08-27) names the operator as شركة بترول بلاعيم (Belayim Petroleum Co / Petrobel), headed by chairman Eng. Atef Hassan, developing the Baltim field under Egypt's Ministry of Petroleum. Independently corroborated by dailynewsegypt.com (English, 2019-08-27), which states Belayim Petroleum (Petrobel) operates the Baltim South West gas field and completed the pipeline/platform work. Both sources match the GEM value 'Belayim Petroleum Co' / شركة بترول بلاعيم exactly (Petrobel is Belayim Petroleum's common trade name; standard GEM entity, no fabrication). No value contradictions found; two independent outlets (Egyptian financial-news site vs. English-language daily) agree.
